cohort: The study included 89,276 extremely preterm deliveries (live births and stillbirths) to Hispanic, non-Hispanic (NH) Black, and NH white mothers in California from 1989 to 2015.
finding: Findings indicate an inverse correlation between stillbirth and early neonatal death in the same cohort year among extremely preterm deliveries (coefficient: -0.27, 95% CI of - 0.11; - 0.42).
followup_time: Less than 7 days of life (for early neonatal death)
